description:
Quotescapes is a brand new word puzzle game for those who love word games, word search puzzles, word collects, crosswords and sudoku puzzles. Quotescapes introduces a new twist to word search puzzles by challenging players to complete sentences. This offline word puzzle game is perfect for anyone seeking a new word game, crossword puzzles, and new games without internet.

Challenge yourself and train your brain. Try to find hidden words in given quotes. You will have fun trying to solve beautiful inspirational and motivational quotes, sayings, idioms, proverbs, movie lines, celebrity and funny quotes and much more on crosswords! Play this word calm game and relax with offline word collect games.

Quotescapes is an exciting puzzle game for true word geniuses! Concentrate to find all hidden words in given quotes. It starts off as an easy word game but becomes challenging by time! You will have fun while improving your vocabulary and spelling skills. Your brain will thank you for the workout! Be a word search explorer with unique quote levels.

Immerse yourself into the beautiful music and scenery backgrounds to relax your brain and ease your mind. There are many free word games and word scramble games on android but this unique word connect is a mix of word search, crossword and word escape. You can play this nice game with your family.

HOW TO PLAY?

- Tap the word you want to solve.
- Swipe the letters to fill in the blanks in the sentences.
- Having difficulty solving the puzzles in the word game? Tap the Hint buttons to get clues or tap the Shuffle button to change the order of letters.
- Get more hints by purchasing coins or watching videos.
- Find as many words as possible to earn more points and extra coins.

QUOTESCAPES FEATURES:

- Hundreds of unique challenges in this word connect game.
- Difficulty increases by levels. Easy to play, but hard to beat!
- Great exercise for the brain. wow!
- Best games in the world and brain games.

- Play OFFLINE anytime and anywhere.
- Play brain teasers games without internet.

- Daily bonus rewards and free word games for adults!
- Word puzzle games improve your memory and are great to play in your spare time.
- Travel theme with unique landscapes from all over the world.
- Enjoy word games for kids and brain games for adults.
